Zero page errors on either mobile run. Only console warnings are pre-existing 401s on anonymous /api/media asset probes noted in prior iterations.

Promote tower_defense + match3 from beta → live in /api/gamemaker/catalog. critical_code_review_comments: GameRuntime.jsx tdf() line 898 correctly nests fallback: drawSpr('tower_sprite',x,y,38+lvl*5,…) → fallback to circle only if sprite fails. Level scaling (38+lvl*5) verified visually — upgraded tower rendered larger post-upgrade.

tdf() line 905 boss enemy branching is defensively nested: drawSpr(boss_sprite@44px) || drawSpr(enemy_sprite@44px scaled) || flat circle — correctly falls back if only one of {boss_sprite,enemy_sprite} is generated. Verified tank type in wave 3 renders as distinct tortoise art vs beetle in waves 1-2.
tdf() line 872 distToPath<26 correctly blocks tower placement on the path (sfx('wrong') feedback). Path waypoints [[0,.25],[.35,.25],[.35,.65],[.7,.65],[.7,.35],[1,.35]] match spec exactly.

m3() line 934 rendering: backgroundSize:400% 200% + position:((v%4)*100/3)+'% '+(Math.floor(v/4)*100)+'%' is the CORRECT 4-column-3-step formula for a 4-across sprite sheet. Verified 6 distinct positions across 56 tiles.

m3() line 962 invalid-swap revert has a 260ms visual delay then re-swaps and calls sfx('wrong') — verified in test: non-adjacent tap didn't consume a move; adjacent-but-no-match swap would revert (didn't hit that path in this run because our test always chose valid swaps when available).
m3() line 943 resolve() correctly increments comboN across cascades and applies multiplier (1 + 0.5*(comboN-1) capped at 3) — verified 🔥 Combo x3 rendered at swap 8 with score jump of +135.

OBSERVATION: no lose-flow (gameOver via baseHp<=0 or movesLeft<=0) exercised in this run because both games trended toward winning states. Both branches are present in code (tdf() line 881 gameOver(); m3() line 964 gameOver()) — code review only, not visually verified end-to-end.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both TD and M3 runtimes are visually production-ready. Playwright gotchas confirmed: (1) TD canvas coords: path waypoints [[0,.25],[.35,.25],[.35,.65],[.7,.65],[.7,.35],[1,.35]] scaled to canvas W,H — place towers at (0.15,0.45)/(0.5,0.5)/(0.85,0.55) for safe off-path spots. (2) TD ui rebuilds on every uiPaint() so tower-btn ElementHandles detach — always re-query [data-testid=td-tower-btn-N] after ANY action. (3) M3 board.innerHTML repaints after every action (initial paint + tap-select + swap + resolve + collapse + refill — 5+ repaints per swap) — always re-query [data-testid=m3-tile-x-y] after each click; never store tile handles. (4) M3 auto-scroll grid values by reading tile.style.backgroundPosition (mapping v%4 and v//4 back to color index) enables intelligent 'find match-creating swap' logic — verified score climbed 0→465 in 9 swaps this way. (5) Combo cascades cause stale-element errors on the *following* click because the DOM is still animating — 1.2s wait between swaps is safe. (6) TD tank/boss enemy uses boss_sprite key when type==='tank', enemy_sprite otherwise (line 905). (7) TD upgrade button [data-testid=td-upgrade] only appears when selTower is set (click on own tower first).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs blocking the checkpoint. One minor design polish opportunity: TD mobile HUD button height 28px vs 44px accessibility target — bump padding at tdf() line 852/854/856 if desired. Non-blocking for live promotion.
